parent: P25 original ten-task evidence and endpoint reconciliation

endpoint_label_rule.PASS: Only a unique original complete benchmark oracle with positive F2P test count, ALL F2P passed, zero P2P failures, and no documented systemic endpoint QC failure. This is a task-oracle pass, not universal source correctness.
endpoint_label_rule.FAIL_F2P: Only a unique original complete oracle with positive F2P test count and at least one F2P failure, EXCEPT when a documented systemic setup/import failure invalidates the test endpoint.
endpoint_label_rule.UNKNOWN_BASELINE: F2P all passed but P2P failed; no eligible matching original-source negative control to establish that candidate caused the P2P failure. In the Kedro case do not silently impute candidate causality.
endpoint_label_rule.UNKNOWN_ENDPOINT_IMPORT: Original raw oracle reported unresolved but exact source log reveals missing test fixture import swe100_fixture_clock, so raw result is not an admitted code-repair verdict.
endpoint_label_rule.UNKNOWN_BASELINE_REPRODUCED: Original source candidate passes F2P but fails P2P; exactly the same failed P2P tests also occur on original historical source with only a README comment. Raw original verdict stays unresolved and baseline-relative source correctness is not universally certified.
endpoint_label_rule.NO_CANDIDATE: The ninth original frozen Reflex task has no source candidate or original task oracle; exclude from policy coverage denominator while retaining in original ten-task selection.
endpoint_label_rule.note: The split is an evidence-admission convention for the specific original issue tests; failed F2P is direct evidence that the original issue criterion is not met, not a theorem of absence of any useful source change.

sharp_bounds_rule.notation: For a fixed policy, A is the set of decisions ACCEPT among the nine cases with recorded original P9 decisions. Among A, F are directly failed F2P with valid test execution; S are task-oracle passes; U are unresolved/invalid endpoint-or-baseline attribution. The true binary full-task failure rate among A lies in [|F|/|A|, (|F|+|U|)/|A|] if unknown task statuses may be either pass or fail, and no additional cross-task assumptions are imposed.
sharp_bounds_rule.sharpness: Both endpoint extremes are attained under completing every unknown accepted task as pass or every unknown accepted task as fail; this is a standard partial-identification argument, not a new theorem or safety certification.
sharp_bounds_rule.source_coverage_rule: Acceptance coverage is |A|/9, counting all source-candidate tasks whether or not the outcome is known. This is an observed process fraction, not a generalizable rate.
sharp_bounds_rule.homogeneity: Mixed-stage historical case set; comparisons may be sensitive to candidate stage. No population confidence interval, p-value, causal effect, calibration or claimed policy superiority.

manuscripts: MR30 review paper remains LOCKED; P26 result only a standalone research extension for future author-approved companion paper.
